نفتضخ (form VIII)

# نُفْتَضَخُ (nuftaḍaḵu) /nuf.ta.dˤa.xu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# نَفْتَضِخَ (naftaḍiḵa) /naf.ta.dˤi.xa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# نُفْتَضَخَ (nuftaḍaḵa) /nuf.ta.dˤa.x
